mapper.sql: a.article_id, a.category_id, c.category_name, a.article_title as title, a.source_type, a.audience_type, a.article_status as status, a.current_version_no, a.pinned, case a.audience_type when 1 then '全体员工' when 2 then '指定员工组' else '未知范围' end as audience_type_name, coalesce((select group_concat(distinct r.role_name order by r.role_sort, r.role_id separator '、') from ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_article_role ar inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_role r on r.tenant_id = ar.tenant_id and r.member_id = ar.member_id and r.role_id = ar.role_id and r.status = 0 and r.is_delete = 0 where ar.article_id = a.article_id and ar.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ar.member_id = a.member_id and ar.is_delete = 0), '') as role_names, (select count(1) from ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_read_record rr where rr.article_id = a.article_id and rr.is_delete = 0) as read_count, date_format(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, date_format(a.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as update_time

select c.category_id, c.parent_id, c.category_name, c.sort_no, c.status, (case when c.member_id = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as platform_category from ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_category c where c.is_delete = 0 and (c.member_id = 0 or c.member_id = #{memberId}) order by platform_category desc, c.parent_id asc, c.sort_no asc, c.category_id asc

select c.category_id, c.parent_id, c.category_name, c.sort_no, c.status, (case when c.member_id = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as platform_category from ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_category c where c.category_id = #{categoryId} and c.is_delete = 0 and (c.member_id = 0 or c.member_id = #{memberId}) limit 1

select category_id, parent_id, category_name, sort_no, status, 0 as platform_category from ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_category where category_id = #{categoryId} and member_id = #{memberId} and is_delete = 0 limit 1

update ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_category set is_delete = 1, remove_by = #{operator}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where category_id = #{categoryId} and member_id = #{memberId} and is_delete = 0
mapper.select:
select from ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_article a left join ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_category c on c.category_id = a.category_id and c.is_delete = 0 and (c.member_id = 0 or c.member_id = #{memberId})
a.is_delete = 0
and a.member_id is null and a.source_type = 1 and a.article_status = 1
and a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.source_type = 2 and (a.audience_type = 1 or a.create_by = #{merchantUserId} or exists (select 1 from ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_article_role ar inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_user_role ur on ur.tenant_id = ar.tenant_id and ur.member_id = ar.member_id and ur.role_id = ar.role_id and ur.merchant_user_id = #{merchantUserId} and ur.is_delete = 0 where ar.article_id = a.article_id and ar.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ar.member_id = #{memberId} and ar.is_delete = 0) or exists (select 1 from ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_user_role ur inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_role r on r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id and r.member_id = ur.member_id and r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.role_key = 'merchant_admin' and r.status = 0 and r.is_delete = 0 where ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ur.member_id = #{memberId} and ur.merchant_user_id = #{merchantUserId} and ur.is_delete = 0))
and ((a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.source_type = 2) or (a.member_id is null and a.source_type = 1 and a.article_status = 1))
and (a.member_id is null or a.audience_type = 1 or a.create_by = #{merchantUserId} or exists (select 1 from ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_article_role ar inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_user_role ur on ur.tenant_id = ar.tenant_id and ur.member_id = ar.member_id and ur.role_id = ar.role_id and ur.merchant_user_id = #{merchantUserId} and ur.is_delete = 0 where ar.article_id = a.article_id and ar.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ar.member_id = #{memberId} and ar.is_delete = 0) or exists (select 1 from ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_user_role ur inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_role r on r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id and r.member_id = ur.member_id and r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.role_key = 'merchant_admin' and r.status = 0 and r.is_delete = 0 where ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ur.member_id = #{memberId} and ur.merchant_user_id = #{merchantUserId} and ur.is_delete = 0))
and a.article_title like concat('%', #{query.title}, '%')
and a.category_id = #{query.categoryId} and a.article_status = #{query.status}
order by a.pinned desc, a.update_time desc, a.article_id desc

select from ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_article a left join ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_category c on c.category_id = a.category_id and c.is_delete = 0 and (c.member_id = 0 or c.member_id = #{memberId}) where a.article_id = #{articleId} and a.is_delete = 0 and ((a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.source_type = 2) or (a.member_id is null and a.source_type = 1 and a.article_status = 1)) and (a.member_id is null or a.audience_type = 1 or a.create_by = #{merchantUserId} or exists (select 1 from ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_article_role ar inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_user_role ur on ur.tenant_id = ar.tenant_id and ur.member_id = ar.member_id and ur.role_id = ar.role_id and ur.merchant_user_id = #{merchantUserId} and ur.is_delete = 0 where ar.article_id = a.article_id and ar.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ar.member_id = #{memberId} and ar.is_delete = 0) or exists (select 1 from ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_user_role ur inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_role r on r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id and r.member_id = ur.member_id and r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.role_key = 'merchant_admin' and r.status = 0 and r.is_delete = 0 where ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ur.member_id = #{memberId} and ur.merchant_user_id = #{merchantUserId} and ur.is_delete = 0)) limit 1

select from ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_article a left join ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_category c on c.category_id = a.category_id and c.is_delete = 0 and (c.member_id = 0 or c.member_id = #{memberId}) where a.article_id = #{articleId} and a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.source_type = 2 and a.is_delete = 0 limit 1 for update

select v.version_id, v.version_no, cast(v.content as char) as content, v.version_status, date_format(v.retention_until, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as retention_until, date_format(v.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time from ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_version v where v.article_id = #{articleId} and v.is_delete = 0 and exists ( select 1 from ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_article a where a.article_id = v.article_id and a.is_delete = 0 and ((a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.source_type = 2) or (a.member_id is null and a.source_type = 1 and a.article_status = 1)) and (a.member_id is null or a.audience_type = 1 or a.create_by = #{merchantUserId} or exists (select 1 from ry_rental.ry_rental_knowledge_article_role ar inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_user_role ur on ur.tenant_id = ar.tenant_id and ur.member_id = ar.member_id and ur.role_id = ar.role_id and ur.merchant_user_id = #{merchantUserId} and ur.is_delete = 0 where ar.article_id = a.article_id and ar.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ar.member_id = #{memberId} and ar.is_delete = 0) or exists (select 1 from ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_user_role ur inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_merchant_role r on r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id and r.member_id = ur.member_id and r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.role_key = 'merchant_admin' and r.status = 0 and r.is_delete = 0 where ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ur.member_id = #{memberId} and ur.merchant_user_id = #{merchantUserId} and ur.is_delete = 0)) ) order by v.version_no desc, v.version_id desc
